addition: kind:add uses the existing item window and one existing qualified warehouse; deterministic added line, original order, original fulfillment rows and original invoice identity.
approval: Explicit current authenticated customer confirmation binds exact quote, source order, item, quantity, terms and total. Existing independent merchant review is additionally required.
recheck: Before every source add-line stage, recheck current scope, approver permissions, customer confirmation, execution controls and recovery; source transaction also checks original native consent and approved terms.
financial_and_physical_stages: Native commit, unpaid invoice, settlement, warehouse acknowledgment, owned-hold release and shipment stay distinct.
unknown_outcome: Existing original operation lookup; never create another order, invoice or fulfillment as repair.
privacy: Offers and confirmations are customer scoped. Canonical erasure and restore revoke confirmations; native consent copies and original source customer records require separate operator cleanup.
